message.content: Keysight Technologies sells market-leading design, emulation, and test solutions across the full lifecycle, serving technology innovators as a mission-critical design enablement partner [D1]. Its customers span AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor, and general electronics [D1]. In the third quarter ended July 31, 2026, the Communications Solutions Group reported revenue of $1,345 million, up 43 percent from the prior year, reflecting 56 percent growth in commercial communications and 14 percent growth in aerospace, defense, and government [D1]. The Electronic Industrial Solutions Group reported revenue of $501 million, up 21 percent, reflecting growth across the semiconductor, general electronics and automotive and energy markets [D1].
